question: Tell me about a time you had to influence someone without formal authority.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates ability to drive outcomes through collaboration.
exampleAnswer: I needed the design team to adopt a new component library to reduce development time. Situation: they preferred their existing workflow. I created a proof-of-concept demonstrating 30% faster development and gathered feedback from developers who tested it. I presented the data and addressed their concerns about migration effort. Result: the team adopted the library, and sprint velocity increased by 15%.
evaluationCriteria: Data-driven approach, stakeholder engagement, measurable outcome
followUpQuestions: How do you build credibility with stakeholders?
What if someone still disagrees after data is presented?
How do you measure the success of your influence?
